audit.whatIsWrong: The page opened with a generic 'reference assassin mirror' line that could be pasted onto any assassin. The actual difficulty shape is a hard early lead that decays: 48.61% over 6700 games, with the packet chart giving Zed six rows and Katarina the seventh.
audit.why: Katarina has no shield, no sustain and no ranged answer pre-6; Bouncing Blade is 11s at rank 1. Her takeover is Voracity reset chains at full build.
audit.corrected: tldr, breakdown.early and phases[0..3].why now say bully-then-close with the real cooldown, and phases[6] hands the row to Katarina.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer carried a near-blanket 'Skill' — rows 0,1,2,3,5 Skill and row 6 Skill — while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read Zed,Zed,Zed,Zed,Zed,Zed,Katarina. Six of seven rows disagreed across layers.
audit.why: Pre-6 Zed dominates a Katarina with no shield or sustain; the lethality item lands before her reset chains matter; full build flips it to her.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side, [1].side, [2].side, [3].side and [5].side Skill->Zed, phases[6].side Skill->Katarina, all in one atomic group, with every matching why rewritten in the same proposal — phases[6].why in particular had to stop describing Zed picking people off. No win[N] edits: the content layer already matched the packet, and no-ops would have voided the group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The mid-game text told you to 'W-swap or R-mark to interrupt her ult'. Zed has no hard CC — his E is a slow, and slows do not break a channel.
audit.why: Death Lotus is flagged channel/'interruptible — any CC cancels it', 550 range, 75/60/45s. Zed's kit lists only slow (E) and dash/untargetable (W, R). Nothing in it interrupts.
audit.corrected: mid and spikes[1].text now say to swap out of the 550 radius and state plainly that your slow will not stop it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Voracity's dagger pickup — a slash through all nearby enemies — was never mentioned, so 'don't stand in her daggers' was asserted without the reason.
audit.why: Riot passive text: 'If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.' Plus: a champion dying that she damaged recently dramatically reduces her remaining cooldowns.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d now states the pickup slash; ahead and enemyWin state that Voracity refunds only off a kill.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Shunpo 12/11/10/9/8s at 725 range, Bouncing Blade 11/10/9/8/7s at 625, Death Lotus 75/60/45s.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with all three and what each window permits.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file flags Bouncing Blade as 'grounding' and Preparation as 'knockup'. Riot's descriptions support neither ('throws a Dagger that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground'; 'gains a burst of Move Speed, tossing a Dagger into the air directly above herself').
audit.why: Tooltip parsing misfired on 'ground' and 'into the air'. Per the brief's rule the description wins.
audit.corrected: Nothing about grounding or knockup was written into any field.

notes: Biggest correction: the page twice told you to interrupt Death Lotus with a W-swap or R-mark. Zed has no hard CC — E is a slow — so the channel cannot be broken by anything in his kit; both places now say to leave the 550 radius instead. Level chart: the full layer was a near-blanket 'Skill' (six of seven rows) against a content layer and packet that both read Zed x6 then Katarina; flipped all six sides as one atomic group and rewrote every matching why, including phases[6].why which had been describing Zed picking people off under a row now owned by Katarina. Derived flags on Bouncing Blade (grounding) and Preparation (knockup) contradict Riot's own descriptions and were not used.
